## What's new

- **Free flight – a new tour style.** Under ⚙︎ → Tour, switch from *Mind map* to *Free flight*: every branch becomes a card floating in space, its points float around it at different depths, and the camera flies through space from one to the next. Skip ahead and the stations in between rush past; at the end every card flies past the camera into one grid – the whole picture.
- **Callout boxes.** `> [!NOTE]`, `> [!TIP]`, `> [!IMPORTANT]`, `> [!WARNING]` and `> [!CAUTION]` – the same notation as on GitHub – become coloured boxes on the slide, below the title or right below a point. In the mind map: right-click → *Callout box …*.
- **Real speaker notes.** Speaker notes (`<!-- notes: … -->` in Markdown, right-click → *Speaker notes …*) are now separate from the description on the slide. The presenter view and the phone remote show only them, so you never read out what everyone can already see.
- **Smooth presenter view.** The presenter window now draws itself independently of the main window and no longer slows the presentation down.
- **Search that shows what it found.** Search looks through text, descriptions and speaker notes, jumps to the first match while you type, marks every match with a ring and highlights the word – also on collapsed branches and in the Markdown editor.
- **Sound feedback (optional).** Settings → *Sound feedback*: a soft pop for a new node, a chime for a done task, a whoosh when switching views. Every sound is synthesized in the app.
- **New app icon** – a circle with an M, branches and brackets – also in the menu bar.
- **Eight more colour themes** and an editor for your own colours.
- **Status bar:** *Fit to window* and *Auto layout* moved down next to the zoom; *Help → Mindful on GitHub* opens the project page.
- **Keyboard shortcuts** are shown correctly on Mac and Windows everywhere (⌘ vs. Ctrl, ⌫ vs. Del, the emoji picker).
- The AI prompt now also asks for speaker notes and callout boxes, and both examples ("The Universe", "Das Weltall") show them.

`.mindmap` files with speaker notes or callouts open in older versions too, but those versions drop the new parts when saving.

## Download

- `Mindful-macos-arm64.zip`: macOS 11 or newer on Apple silicon (M1 and newer)
- `Mindful-windows-x64.zip`: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit

**macOS:** Mindful isn't notarized by Apple yet. After the first launch attempt, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Alternatively, run:

```
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Mindful.app
```

**Windows:** unzip and start `Mindful.exe`. There is no installer. SmartScreen warns on the first start: click **More info → Run anyway**.
